utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the first of June. Everyone on? I won't ask how you feel about the football last night.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Probably safer not to. Better subject: the charity bake sale on Friday. Those brownies were decent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: The charity bake sale on Friday has ruined shop-bought cake for me. Although yours needed a bandsaw, Callum.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Structural flapjack. There's a market for that.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a materials review. Finished bits first, then what we're actually taking on.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, tested the fire panel yesterday and it's all fine now. That's closed, nothing new off that.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Lovely. Nice to have one that's actually finished.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And I tested the line 2 yesterday and it's all fine now. Same thing, done rather than something for today's list.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, understood. Not carrying that over.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I noticed the turbine one was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. Just an observation, not raising another job.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: It settled while they were still running, yeah?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, it came back down. Nothing further coming out of that here.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Other bit: the supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the cooling tower. That's still blocked, not a fresh action this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right. No confirmed delivery to build anything round, then. Still blocked.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And we can't get to the GT2 until production gives us a window. We haven't got that window.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. GT2 stays blocked; we're not pretending we've agreed access.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fiona Doyle, can you take vibration readings on the GT1 tomorrow? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that one on. I haven't got the capacity for the readings.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Grace, could you take that instead? The GT1 readings, same timing.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take vibration readings on the GT1 tomorrow. Normal priority. That's with me instead of Fiona Doyle.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Thanks. Grace on that one, tomorrow, normal priority. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Then there's the pressure drop on the Water Booster Pump. That needs investigating.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll investigate the pressure drop on the Water Booster Pump. It's urgent, that one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Is that being lumped in with the filter, or—

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, sorry, separate. I'm investigating the pressure drop, not assuming the filter is the cause.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Okay, Tomasz Nowak has the Water Booster Pump pressure-drop investigation, and it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: On the filter itself, I'll swap the filter on the water booster today. Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: So that one's definitely today, just not the same urgency as the pressure drop?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Exactly. Today, but not an emergency.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, Grace Liu for the water booster filter. Two separate jobs, not one duplicated line.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Olumide Adeyemi, can you recalibrate the sensors on the line 1 mould temp on the 3rd? Fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: On the 3rd, so Wednesday, yeah? Not pulling that into this morning?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, on the 3rd. Fairly important, but that is the agreed timing.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep, accepted. I'll recalibrate the sensors on the line 1 mould temp on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And that's a recalibration, rather than just checking what the display says?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, recalibrate the sensors. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Hannah, can you go to Northfield Substation to pick up the replacement parts for the Forklift Fleet tomorrow? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, just to be clear, that's the collection we're agreeing, not fitting them as well?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just collection. Northfield Substation, replacement parts for the Forklift Fleet. Tomorrow, first because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, I'll go to Northfield Substation to pick up the replacement parts for the Forklift Fleet tomorrow. I'll do that first.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Collection only against Hannah, then. No fitting job implied.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, the production hold is why that one's right up there.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And I'll check the guarding on the IM1 after lunch. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah Price. IM1 guarding check after lunch, first in that slot because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, that's what I mean. After lunch, that comes first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. And a check on the list isn't the same as saying it's already okay to run.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Absolutely. We've agreed the guarding check, not a result before it's happened.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks tomorrow as well. Normal priority for that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tomasz for the Boiler Feedwater Pump leak inspection, tomorrow, normal priority?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's right. Separate from the urgent pressure-drop investigation.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the Boiler Feedwater Pump by 11am. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. Permit to work and isolation for the Boiler Feedwater Pump by 11am, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, both parts of that are mine. Not just the permit paperwork.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Understood. That doesn't change my leak inspection from tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. Different timing for the two. The permit and isolation—

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you. You went all robot for a second.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: We lost half that sentence here too. Go again?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just the timings: Aisha's permit and isolation by 11am, Grace Liu's water booster filter today. The Boiler Feedwater Pump leak inspection is tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And my two aren't competing in the same slot: IM1 guarding after lunch, Forklift Fleet parts from Northfield Substation tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Both production holds, so first after lunch for the guarding, first tomorrow for the collection. That's how I've heard it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, exactly.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. And just so the blocked bits don't creep into the agreed work: still no supplier confirmation for the cooling tower.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same with GT2. No production window, still blocked. Nothing taken on against it.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And the fire panel stays in the finished column. Yesterday's test was fine.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Same for line 2. Finished yesterday, not another job today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right, that's the agreed list. Thanks, everyone. Teams has mostly behaved for once.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Unlike the flapjack, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: It had excellent load-bearing properties. Cheers, all.
